what: Explanation of the R markdown Templates
title: CommuteCA: Datasets and Methods for Job Accessibility in Canada
text: {CommuteCa} R Markdown Templates. {CommuteCA} package includes R Markdown templates guide users entire accessibility analysis workflow. illustrated Figure , templates enable analysts : Mode job accessibility Census Tract (CT) level multiple CMAs CAs without requiring special access confidential census microdata files. Model job accessibility Dissemination Area (DA) level study area Canada, including areas outside metropolitan regions. Exclusively researchers access census microdata files. R Markdown files available /data-raw folder clone repository GitHub. installed package, can access R Markdown templates RStudio navigating File > New File > R Markdown... > Template selecting one CommuteCA R Markdown templates. package provides seven (now) R Markdown templates, organized three progressive groups: Template 1: introduces R language, literate programming concepts, data objects, basic operations, measurement scales, fundamental data manipulation techniques. Template 2: perform exploratory data analysis, including descriptive statistics appropriate visualizations different variable types. Template 3: obtain spatial files via {cancensus} package, generating travel-time matrices using {r5r} routing engine. Template 4: calculate job accessibility using traditional Hansen accessibility measure (gravity model) spatial availability model proposed Soukhov et al. (2023). Template 5: create maps visualize job accessibility indicators. Template 6: construct spatial filters accessibility indicators. Template 7: estimate regression models link accessibility employment outcomes.

title: Calculate a spatial filter for a spatial variable based on a set of eigenvectors — calculate_spatial_filter
text: function performs forward selection procedure: Join spatial_data_frame matrix_eigv specified key. Initialize Sf = 0 x = 1. eigenvector (order appear joined data), fit model response ~ x + Sf + EV_i. coefficient EV_i p-value < threshold, add coef(EV_i) * EV_i Sf. Return data frame ID, response, filter, groups. procedure applied independently group defined group_vars, results row-bound single data frame.
